item.description: Every time Rowan Zorilla steps on his board, it’s a live performance. He makes the most difficult skating look effortless, and his first signature shoe was designed with that in mind. The Skate Rowan may look laid back on its surface, but dig a little deeper and the layers of complexity begin to reveal themselves. With progressive features and time-tested materials, this vulcanized shoe encourages you to put on a performance of your own. UNRIVALED DURABILITY - Reinforced DURACAP™ underlays in high-wear areas add unrivaled durability to prolong the life of each shoe. LEGENDARY GRIP - Our proprietary SickStick™ gum rubber compound is our stickiest rubber yet. POPCUSH™ CUSHIONING - Our best cushioning and impact protection. PopCush™ energy return footbeds protect your feet while helping to lessen leg fatigue for longer skate sessions. CLASSIC MATERIALS - The Rowan is made with sturdy suede and 10 oz canvas uppers for an iconic Vans® look.
